references.text: Psalm 95:6 calls for worship and prayer together, which resonates with the promise in Matthew 18:20 about God's presence when two or three are gathered in His name.
Isaiah 66:2 highlights God's attention toward the humble and repentant, which can be seen in connection with God's presence among those who gather in His name according to Matthew 18:20.
Acts 2:1-47 describes how believers gathered together and experienced God's presence and work, paralleling the promise in Matthew 18:20 about God's presence in community.
Hebrews 10:24-25 encourages us not to neglect meeting together, which underscores the importance of gathering in community as mentioned in Matthew 18:20.
